criteria.sufficiency: Committed predecessor evidence and the candidate diff establish that historical records were preserved rather than reclassified.
Each configured evaluator classification is submitted through the governed result path, proving configuration—not a kernel special case—accepts and routes it.
Invalid cross-field combinations are rejected before result acceptance and every valid combination reaches an explicit configured outcome.
Repeated equivalent allocation produces one execution under the same resolved grant.
Changed resolved authority is observed as conflict or a required reconciliation, never as an equivalent duplicate.
A forced continuation allocation failure leaves durable inspection evidence after the caller path ends.
A bounded correction cycle reaches an inspectable human gate before another automatic allocation.
A separately authorized WEG starts with fresh retry and semantic-work accounting.
A live non-terminal governed execution blocks a second governed authority while an unadopted supervisor remains permissible.
The ordered supersession proof records authority first, rejects late old-authority requests, reconciles the old process, then admits replacement work.
Skill discovery with ordinary continuation authority cannot create a worker grant or canonical role result.
The same attached session is permitted only by explicit or mechanically satisfied fallback authority and resumes supervision after terminal execution.
Recorded evaluator-private provenance prevents forbidden inline implementation adoption.
Requested, host-enforced, and runtime-confirmed executor facts are distinguished, and unattestable exact constraints block allocation.
The same committed-looking artifact is denied without governed provenance and accepted only when the configured path binds the authorized execution and result.
A bounded evaluator request causes host validation and promotion with exact source/destination identities, without direct executor publication authority.
A denied or failed host action is recorded separately and leaves the already valid semantic PASS intact.
The historical reader remains observable while every post-cutover legacy mutation route is mechanically unavailable.
A new human decision is accepted only by the configured authority path and cannot be changed by legacy state.
Direct predicate cases establish false without an anchor and true only after a matching anchor, with visible regression coverage.
The complete supported visible suite establishes retained baseline behaviour and detects kernel-regression breakage.
A real spawned clean exit without a result yields durable missing-result handling, while valid result delivery advances separately from process exit.
A contradictory fixture is rejected and a governed Brief Readiness execution produces its declared artifact within its granted capability.
